releases.body:
## Fixes

- Restore assistant reply translation on newer OpenCode releases by routing WebSocket-configured providers through HTTP.
- Translate AI SDK text streams even when a provider plugin uses its own fetch implementation, including the integration pattern used by `oc-codex-multi-auth@6.24.0`, in either plugin order.
- Preserve English-only model history, prevent duplicate translations, and strip internal session tags before sending provider requests.
- Propagate stream cancellation and provider read failures.

## Verification

- 101 tests; lint, typecheck, unused-code checks, coverage, and packed-package installation pass.
- OpenCode 2.0.3: stateless translation and session-only translation with legacy configuration pass.
- OpenCode 2.0.16: native OpenAI and multi-auth-style AI SDK providers pass in both plugin orders, with two bilingual turns and English-only follow-up context.
- The publish workflow verifies the exact npm package through OpenCode before creating this release.
- Live OpenCode 2.0.16 verification with the released npm package and `oc-codex-multi-auth@6.24.0`: both `openai/gpt-6-astra` and `openai/gpt-6-sol` translated initial and follow-up replies into Korean exactly once.

## Upgrade

Set the translation plugin package to `opencode-translate@2.0.9` in your OpenCode configuration. Keep your existing translation options and `oc-codex-multi-auth` entry.

The plugin requires HTTP for native response translation, so loading it disables the session WebSocket fast path for affected providers in that location.
